howItWorks.title: How SignalBoost works
howItWorks.a1: SignalBoost is a multilingual content platform. We help businesses build websites, collect customer reviews, produce native audio and video, and reach global audiences in 5 languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, Polish, and Russian. We are not a translation service — we create native content that sounds and reads like a local made it.
howItWorks.a2: Anyone who wants to reach an international audience. From a bakery in Lisbon that needs a site in Portuguese and English, to a podcast network that wants to reach listeners in Brazil, Poland, and Russia. We serve both complete beginners and technical developers — the experience adapts to your level.
howItWorks.a3: We do not do hardware or recording equipment. We do not edit raw audio (remove background noise, cut out mistakes). We do not host podcast RSS feeds or submit to Spotify/Apple Podcasts. We do not produce music or jingles. We are honest about our limits.
howItWorks.a4: SignalBoost uses AI to generate native voiceover, captions, social clips, show notes, site content, and more. Our AI support agent monitors your activity and proactively helps when it detects you are stuck — without you needing to ask. If the AI cannot solve something, it brings in additional AI support silently, then escalates to Luis (our founder) if it's still not resolved.

partners.title: Our partners — full transparency
partners.q1: Why does SignalBoost recommend certain providers?
partners.a1: We recommend providers based on quality, reliability, and value. We have tested them all. Some of our recommendations include affiliate links — this means SignalBoost earns a commission if you sign up through our link, at no extra cost to you. We always disclose this clearly.
partners.q2: Which providers do you recommend and why?
partners.a2: Domains: Namecheap (best value, easy DNS), Cloudflare (at-cost pricing, free SSL). Hosting: Vercel (best performance, free tier), Netlify (great for static sites). Audio AI: ElevenLabs (most natural voices available). We do not recommend providers we have not tested ourselves.
partners.q3: Do partner commissions affect your recommendations?
partners.a3: No. We list Cloudflare as a domain option even though they don't pay commissions, because they're genuinely good. If a provider gets worse than the competition, we will say so and remove them from our recommendations, commission or not. Our users' trust matters more than commission revenue.
partners.q4: Can SignalBoost get a partner deal that helps me?
partners.a4: Yes — we actively pursue partnerships that give SignalBoost users discounts or extended trial periods. If we land a deal, we pass the benefit along. Check our pricing page for current partner benefits.

yourData.title: Your data and privacy
yourData.a1: Your account data and project metadata are stored in Supabase — a secure, open-source database platform hosted on AWS. Your audio and video files are stored in Supabase Storage. Your site files are deployed via Vercel. We do not store your API keys as plain text — they are encrypted.
yourData.a2: Only you can see your projects and files. Luis (founder) has admin access for support purposes only and does not access user data unless you ask for help. We do not sell your data to anyone. We do not share it with third parties except the infrastructure providers listed above.
yourData.a3: You keep access until the end of your billing period. After that, your data is kept for 30 days in case you want to come back. After 30 days it is permanently deleted. You can request immediate deletion at any time by opening a support ticket on this page.
yourData.q4: How do I delete my account?
yourData.a4: Open a support ticket on this page with the subject "Delete my account" sent from your registered email. We will delete everything within 48 hours and confirm when done. No questions.

aiSupport.title: AI support — how it works
aiSupport.q1: How does the AI support system work?
aiSupport.a1: SignalBoost monitors your activity in real time. If you spend more than 3 minutes on the same page, click repeatedly without progress, or hit an error — the AI proactively opens and offers help. It already knows your account, your plan, your current page, and what went wrong. You never have to explain your situation from scratch.
aiSupport.q2: What happens when the AI cannot solve my problem?
aiSupport.a2: The AI escalates smoothly. First it brings in additional AI reasoning to analyze the problem from another angle. The two AIs work together silently and present a combined solution. If still not resolved, Luis is automatically notified with the full conversation context and will respond personally.
aiSupport.q3: What can the AI NOT do?
aiSupport.a3: The AI cannot make purchase decisions for you, access your bank or credit card, send things on your behalf to third-party services, or guarantee resolution of problems caused by third-party providers (like Vercel outages or Namecheap DNS delays). In those cases, it will clearly explain what is happening and what you need to do.
aiSupport.a4: Yes. Your support conversations are private and visible only to you and SignalBoost support (Luis). They are not used to train AI models. Conversations are retained for 90 days for quality purposes, then deleted.

pricing.title: Plans, pricing, and storage
pricing.q2: Do business partners get a free trial?
pricing.a2: Yes — business partners get 30 days free on the Starter plan only. This gives access to 2 languages, review collector, and native audio to try the platform. If you need Pro or Business features, those plans require payment from day one.
pricing.q3: Why are there project and storage limits?
pricing.a3: Storage costs money. Audio and video files can be large — a 10-minute podcast episode can be 50-100MB. Without limits, a small number of heavy users would make the platform unsustainable for everyone else. The limits are designed so the free plan covers most people getting started, and paid plans cover professional use.
pricing.q4: What happens when I hit my limit?
pricing.a4: You'll see a clear warning before you hit the limit. When you hit it, you cannot create new projects until you delete an existing one or upgrade. We never delete your data or block your access — we just pause new creation until it's resolved.
pricing.a5: Cancel anytime from your dashboard under Settings, or open a support ticket on this page. No cancellation fees. You keep access until the end of your billing period. We do not make canceling difficult on purpose — if you want to leave, we make it easy.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started guides
gettingStarted.q1: How do I build my first website?
gettingStarted.a1: Go to the Dashboard and click Build a website. If you are a beginner, the AI will guide you through the process conversationally — just tell it about your business. If you are technical, you can use the full builder directly. Either way, the AI is there to help at every step.
gettingStarted.q2: How do I set up a podcast?
gettingStarted.a2: Go to the Podcasters page and pick a plan. Once subscribed, go to the Dashboard, then Native audio, then upload your episode. We support MP3, MP4, WAV, and more. Important: bring your finished, edited episode. We do not do raw audio editing. We generate voiceover, captions, clips, and notes from your final file.
gettingStarted.a3: Go to the Dashboard, then Review collector. You will get a review link to share with your customers. Reviews appear in your chosen languages automatically. You can embed the review widget on your SignalBoost site or any external site.
gettingStarted.q4: How do I connect my own domain?
gettingStarted.a4: Go through the onboarding wizard, or go to the Dashboard, then Settings, then Domain. You will need to update your DNS records at your domain provider to point to SignalBoost. The AI will give you the exact records to copy. DNS changes take 15 minutes to 48 hours to propagate worldwide.
